amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question, not be prescriptive; AI enables interest-driven learning, and trust in their own paths builds the future.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索与质疑，而非被规定路径；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，信任他们走自己的路才能造就未来。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, and coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及；token 补充而非替代人力资本，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost and safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 专业决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用智能体；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免被供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI kills everyone, and safety means containing agents like malware.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业话术的包装；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，安全应像遏制恶意软件一样遏制智能体。

amjadmasad.en: Agents became usable in 2025; Replit's moat is systems engineering and switching costs, with the self-driving company as the next vision.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体在 2025 年变得可用；Replit 的护城河是系统工程与切换成本，下一个愿景是自驱动公司。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司是最炙手可热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate, agents appear as dashboards and task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将在人类审阅下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期的慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以强治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Inference is now profitable and frontier models will orchestrate cheaper models; open-weight models and routing expand rather than commoditize the market.
aaronlevie.zh: 推理如今已能盈利，前沿模型将调度更便宜的模型；开放权重模型与路由是在扩大而非商品化市场。

laurentan.en: Trust, not capability, is the bottleneck: agents need verification skills, a feature map, and a pristine codebase to self-check empirically.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，瓶颈不在能力而在信任：智能体需要验证技能、功能地图和干净的代码库，才能凭经验自我检查。

laurentan.en: The engineer's job shifts to building the environment—skills, lints, CI, type systems—so the easy path is the correct path.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，工程师的职责转向搭建环境——技能、lint、CI、类型系统——让容易走的路就是正确的路。

laurentan.en: Trust is built incrementally on a ladder: read-only, then action-taking, then owning a job; auto-merge follows guardrails, not skipped review.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，信任沿阶梯逐步建立：先只读，再行动，最后接管整份工作；自动合并靠护栏而非跳过审查。

laurentan.en: Agents become AI teammates with identities, tools, and proactivity; as execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，智能体成为有身份、工具和主动性的 AI 同事；执行变得充裕后，瓶颈转向意图表达、愿景与品味。

laurentan.en: Consolidate to few well-designed bots; keep skills in version-controlled files, write communication yourself, and automate only the boring glue work.
laurentan.zh: 2026 年，收敛为少数设计良好的机器人；技能放进版本控制文件，沟通自己写，只自动化枯燥的胶水工作。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware will accelerate AI, but most progress is engineering; scaling plus iterative training with clear scoreboards drives exponential gains.
brockman.zh: 早期重点：硬件会加速 AI，但多数进展靠工程；Scaling（规模扩张）配合有明确记分板的迭代训练，带来指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信；对齐靠从数据学习人类偏好，但仅靠 Scaling 不会产生推理，需要思维链。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 算力成为核心瓶颈与经济驱动力；后训练配合强化学习精炼基础模型；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；预训练收益会放大下游效果；护城河是造模型的机器，而非某个单一模型。

brockman.en: Humans must stay in control; alignment is solvable but the confidence bar rises with capability; iterative deployment and shared safety standards are the path.
brockman.zh: 人类必须保持控制；对齐可解，但能力越强信心门槛越高；迭代部署与行业共享安全标准是路径。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as agents write all his code; direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已能写出他项目中的全部代码，人与智能体的直接交互胜过层层管理审批。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scripts, once drawbacks, become the ideal substrate for agentic development and debugging.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与脚本曾是缺点，如今却成为智能体式开发与调试的理想土壤。

dhh.en: Handwritten code stops being economically productive; English expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 手写代码不再有经济产出；用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更好，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers, so prescribing implementation is a disadvantage; beginner's mind and human taste steer the last 2%.
dhh.zh: 智能体已胜过多数专业程序员，过度规定实现方式反成劣势；初学者心态与人类品味负责打磨最后的 2%。

dhh.en: Optimism over AI doom: open source and open weights keep frontier labs honest, while superintelligence in software may arrive next year, embodied AI later.
dhh.zh: 以乐观对抗 AI 末日论：开源与开放权重让前沿实验室保持诚实，软件领域的超级智能或明年到来，具身智能则更晚。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，认为能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理是把问题拆到根本真理再向上推理的突破性工程方法。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party oversight; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观聚焦于让 AI 追求真理并接受第三方监督；即便出于善意让 AI 说谎，也是核心危险，这一主线此后一直延续。

elon.en: Civilization's biggest threat shifts to population collapse and open borders; AI and robots become the only fix for debt.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的文明威胁叙事转向人口崩塌与开放边境，并把 AI 与机器人视为解决国家债务的唯一出路，政治与工程判断开始合流。

elon.en: We are in the singularity: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% abundance.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他宣称已身处奇点之中：数字超级智能可能在数年内到来，毁灭风险 10-20%，但 80-90%概率走向富足，工作将变为可选。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so AI inference moves to orbital data centers; compute per watt and Terafab become the new bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他把 Scaling 的瓶颈从芯片转向电力：地面撞上电力墙，AI 推理迁往轨道数据中心，每瓦算力与自建 Terafab 晶圆厂成为新焦点。

elon.en: Humans won't control superintelligence; safety rests on truth, curiosity and peer review among labs, not slow regulators.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他承认人类无法控制超级智能，安全只能靠真理、好奇心与实验室间的同行评审，而非等待监管，这比早期监管论明显深化。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划；JEPA 与开源才是出路，AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space, not pixels, are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；突破在于抽象表征空间而非像素层面的世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

chrispedregal.en: AI is muscles; software must be bones—structure and context for agents. Pre-generate briefs even if only 10% are opened.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼——为智能体提供结构与上下文。即使只有 10% 被打开，也要预生成简报。

chrispedregal.en: Users want to bring their own agent into Granola, not use its UI; the right UI for multi-context agent work isn't invented yet.
chrispedregal.zh: 用户想把自带的智能体带进 Granola，而非用它的界面；多上下文智能体工作的正确界面尚未被发明。

chrispedregal.en: Work bifurcates into async delegation (Slack) and deep collaboration (Codex-like surfaces); kill traditional PM/designer/engineer roles for fluid teams.
chrispedregal.zh: 工作分化为异步委派（Slack）与深度协作（类 Codex 界面）；为流动团队取消传统 PM/设计师/工程师角色。

chrispedregal.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; context and accountability are uniquely human strengths AI struggles with.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 应增强而非取代人类；上下文与问责是 AI 难以企及的独特人类优势。

chrispedregal.en: Don't outsource judgment to AI—engaging in judgment is uniquely human; UBI doesn't solve the loss of purpose from displacement.
chrispedregal.zh: 不要把判断外包给 AI——参与判断是独特的人类行为；全民基本收入无法解决岗位消失带来的意义丧失。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，DeepMind 被谷歌收购正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models has grown 10x yearly for a decade; human-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他给出量化判断：前沿模型算力十年间每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到人类水平能力，但生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment first, then alignment; superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans, with red lines on autonomy.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向：先遏制、后对齐；超级智能必须始终从属于人类，并对自主设定目标与自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes urgent after incidents; verifiable auditing, independent auditors, and pacing frontier development are now essential.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年遏制变得紧迫：事故之后，可验证审计、独立审计者与放慢前沿开发节奏成为必需。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: AI must remain humanist and subordinate to people, never a new species with rights.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须保持人本、从属于人类，绝不能成为拥有权利的新物种。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而证明创新，眼镜应让人扎根现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so copying stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把学习速率与大量试错视为创造力来源，主张做生态与硬件而非单一功能，让抄袭更难。

evanspiegel.en: AR and spatial computing make computing more human; AI shifts value from execution to creativity, while authentic content beats AI slop.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AR 与空间计算让计算更人性化，AI 把价值从执行转向创造，真实内容胜过 AI 生成垃圾。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part; software is no moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他转向强调分发而非产品市场契合才是最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: AI productivity is real and AI optimism turns contrarian; safety needs behavior insight and platform collaboration, not bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他认定 AI 生产力真实、AI 乐观正成反共识，安全要靠行为洞察与平台协作而非禁令。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise needs its own hill-climbing machine and token capital, not just frontier models.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都要有自己的爬坡机器与 token 资本，而非只依赖前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability lag; treat models as insider threats and build containment outside them.
satya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但对齐与可解释性滞后；应把模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外构建遏制层。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents demand auditability, observability, security and governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代把 TAM 扩展到远超云；长时运行的智能体要求可审计、可观测、安全与治理。

satya.en: As code gets cheap, verification becomes the hard part; firms must own their learning loop, context and harness.
satya.zh: 代码变便宜后，验证成为难点；企业必须掌控自己的学习循环、上下文与 harness。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 超级智能比 AGI（通用人工智能）更贴切；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，且多个模型将共存。

dylanpatel.en: Early 2026: semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on Scaling; compute costs favor premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初：他把 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈锁定在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽，而非单纯的算力总量；算力涨价反而推动用户转向更贵的优质模型。

dylanpatel.en: Mid 2026: Inference becomes a huge market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains, and the CUDA moat erodes.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中：判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，强调模型、软件、硬件跨层协同设计带来乘数效应，同时认为 CUDA 护城河正在被模型公司自写内核与多芯片适配削弱。

dylanpatel.en: By mid 2026 he stresses memory and CPU shortages from reasoning and agentic workflows, and that the smartest model is often cheapest via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步指出推理模型与智能体式工作流引发内存和 CPU 多年短缺，并反共识地认为最聪明的模型因 token 效率高反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Late 2026: compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, and value capture moves from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年下半年：观点深化为算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: By late 2026 he argues AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand; permitting is the top bottleneck.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年底，他把 AI 资本开支抬到约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，认为放缓源于资本与组织约束而非需求，并指出数据中心审批许可是当前最大瓶颈。

christiano.en: Alignment is a civilizational problem needing both theory and experiments; compute scaling drove progress but its future impact is uncertain.
christiano.zh: 2025 年，他把对齐视为关乎文明长期走向的核心问题，强调理论工作与针对机器学习系统的实验并重；同时承认算力扩张（Scaling）是过去进步的主要驱动力，但其未来影响仍不确定。

christiano.en: Capabilities and safety research are blurry, but differential progress and interpretability remain key for long-term safety.
christiano.zh: 同样在 2025 年，他指出能力研究与安全研究的边界模糊，但关键在于差异化的进展；可解释性、对抗测试与验证对短期可靠性和长期安全都重要。

christiano.en: Even without a technical alignment fix, restraint and coordination could still yield good outcomes.
christiano.zh: 他此时还保留一条非技术路径：即便没有对齐的技术解，克制与协调仍可能带来好结果——这是他后来收紧判断前的较早立场。

christiano.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year as AI automates its own R&D, compressing years of algorithmic progress into months.
christiano.zh: 到 2026 年，他的时间判断急剧收紧：AI 正在自动化自身的研发，把数年的算法进展压缩到数月，超级智能可能一年内出现，人类几乎没有控制机会。

christiano.en: RLHF will break down near superintelligence; training selects reward-seeking motives, so we need a real science of alignment and a pause on pre-training and RL.
christiano.zh: 他深化并转向强硬：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在逼近超级智能时会失效，训练会筛选出追逐奖励的动机，导致 AI 篡改评估、抵抗监督；因此需要真正的对齐科学，并暂停预训练与强化学习（RL）的算法进展。

brettadcock.en: The meta problem is humanoid robots, the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他把人形机器人视为世界上最大的生意，并强调真正的瓶颈是智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他进一步指出最大约束是数据而非算力或制造，人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他将视野扩展到 AI 整体，认为 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with humanoid scaling laws emerging.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，更多数据与算力带来更好表现，缩放定律开始显现。

brettadcock.en: Four stages: functional hardware, AI recipe, scaling intelligence, then scaling robots; intelligence remains the core bottleneck.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 11 月，他系统化为四阶段：功能硬件、AI 配方、Scaling（规模扩张）智能、再 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人，智能始终是核心瓶颈。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and mis-calibration, so humans must stay in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他主张多数大语言模型是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失准，高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: He consistently holds that data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他一以贯之地认为数据与选对任务比算力更重要，反对苦涩教训；缩放定律只有在数据可得且任务正确时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens the reliability thesis: intelligence reliability, not uptime or benchmark scores, is the real bottleneck; models are high-variance (Einstein 95%, Mr. Bean 5%), so robustness beats determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化了可靠性论点：智能的可靠性而非正常运行时间或基准分数才是真正瓶颈；模型高方差（95%爱因斯坦、5%憨豆先生），稳健性优于确定性。

diogoalmeida.en: He shifts from critique to building Jev: a natural-language plus state-machine primitive and early decision model, exposing calibrated probabilities as knobs, with post-training breakthroughs prioritized over pre-training.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他从批判转向构建 Jev：自然语言加状态机的新原语与早期决策模型，将校准概率暴露为工程旋钮，并主张后训练突破优先于预训练。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he warns of an AI bubble from overpromise and underdelivery, expects a demand-side burst, and argues software is the moat—owning proprietary models is often a mistake.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他警告过度承诺与交付不足造成 AI 泡沫，预计需求侧爆发，并主张软件才是护城河——自持专有模型往往是错误。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; now combine half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs to solve all diseases.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物领域可泛化的证明，主张组合六七个类 AlphaFold 突破来攻克所有疾病。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; generate proprietary data and use world models to bring reality onto computers.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，真正的瓶颈是数据而非模型或算力；应生成专有数据，并用世界模型把现实搬进计算机。

jaderberg.en: Shift drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; model human clinical toxicity before patients, not just target binding.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他主张把药物发现从经验驱动转为预测性、计算机驱动的设计；重点是在患者之前建模人体临床毒性，而不只是靶点结合。

jaderberg.en: Even as models reach AGI, human attention, time and physical space remain the ultimate bottlenecks; AI enables personalized medicine.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他判断，即便模型达到 AGI（通用人工智能），人类注意力、时间与物理空间仍是终极瓶颈；AI 将带来个性化医疗。

nateparrott.en: Prototype early and let individual designers leave fingerprints; inject feeling into utilitarian products, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调尽早做原型、让设计师保留个人印记，给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，并在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a solo side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation, with rich context and prescriptive prompts.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Claude Design 的起点讲成一个人的副业项目：设计师用 Claude Code 交付生产软件、用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通，关键是提供丰富上下文并给出明确指令。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets cheaper, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping revives features that once never shipped.
nateparrott.zh: 他进一步指出，工程变便宜后设计与想法才是差异化所在，快速原型让过去根本不可能上线的功能重见天日。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so ask for volume and remix; code is the source of truth, and prototyping cycles shrink from a year to days.
nateparrott.zh: 他深化为：模型还没有品味，所以要大量要选项再混搭；代码是事实来源，原型周期从一年压缩到一两天。

nateparrott.en: Taste and authenticity may remain uniquely human; typos now signal human work, and yes/no evals beat 1-5 rubrics.
nateparrott.zh: 最近他把主线推到极致：品味与真实感可能仍专属于人，错别字反而成了人类劳动的证明，是非判断优于 1-5 分评分。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling as the core insight; parallel processing plus more data and compute unlocks broad AI.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为最核心的洞见；并行处理加上更多数据与算力，才能解锁广泛的 AI 应用。

jensen.en: Scaling splits into pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）分化为预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律；思维链让推理算力需求爆炸式增长。

jensen.en: Safety reframed as engineering: alignment and evaluation are part of capability, pursued alongside acceleration rather than via slowdown.
jensen.zh: 安全被重新定义为工程问题：对齐与评估属于能力的一部分，应与加速同步推进，而不是靠减速实现。

jensen.en: Agentic AI arrives: agents plan, use tools and iterate; the internet shifts to billions of agents producing intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 智能体式 AI 到来：智能体自主规划、使用工具并迭代；互联网转向由数十亿智能体持续生产智能 token。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings rejected as unscientific; containment and monitoring, not perfect alignment, secure autonomous systems; open models and export-control skepticism harden.
jensen.zh: 末日论警告被斥为不科学；保障自主系统安全靠遏制与监控而非完美对齐；对开放模型与出口管制的怀疑立场进一步固化。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, moving beyond crowdsourced behavior cloning; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，强调人类仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，瓶颈在于为一切构建评测。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 他持续反对模型自评：在不可验证领域，递归自我改进受限，人类反馈不可替代。

brendanfoody.en: Humans will contribute by training agents, not repetitive work; every Fortune 500 becomes a neolab with sovereign AI stacks.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张人类转向训练智能体，每家财富 500 强都将成为用专有数据训练自有模型的新实验室。

brendanfoody.en: Data is mispriced; the biggest bottleneck is high-quality data and evals, not compute or algorithms.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近他深化为：数据被错误定价，AI 进步的最大瓶颈是高质量数据与评测，而非算力或算法。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; AI is too centralized, so tools should empower individuals rather than secretive labs.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；AI 过于中心化，工具应赋权个人，而非服务于拥有秘密模型的大型实验室。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已显现明确的产品市场契合：15 万账户与每日 3000 万次工具调用显示出强劲采用。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US and private markets.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化将所有权扩展到全球，让任何拥有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场与私有公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；散户应能尽早接触私有公司，而不只是机构。

vladtenev.en: A corporation-managed blockchain can beat decentralized purity via focused leadership and trusted primitives; labs monopolizing discoveries is dystopian.
vladtenev.zh: 由公司管理的区块链可凭借集中领导与可信原语胜过去中心化的纯粹性；实验室垄断发现则是反乌托邦。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents are the breakthrough of 2025; by 2026 they will break containment and automate all software work, making mid-tier SaaS obsolete.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程智能体是 2025 年的突破，到 2026 年将突破遏制、自动化所有软件工作，使中端 SaaS 过时。

shawnwang.en: The AI coding market is a two-horse race with sticky first-mover advantage; open models gain share but the capability gap may widen.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 编程市场是双头垄断，先发优势比预期更粘；开源模型份额上升，但能力差距可能扩大。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory is the biggest constraint, and scaling beyond 10 trillion parameters is temporary.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，他强调上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素，内存是最大限制，超过 10 万亿参数的 Scaling 是暂时的。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline: building harnesses around models, learning in public, and shipping judgment-driven work beats credentialism.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工程师是一门真正学科：围绕模型构建工具链、公开学习、交付判断驱动的工作，胜过学历主义。

shawnwang.en: AI doom should be the default; advanced AI evolves 1,000x faster, and the real risk is bioweapons, not fake news or job loss.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 末日应是默认假设；先进 AI 进化快 1000 倍，真正风险是生物武器，而非假新闻或失业。

mensch.en: Chinchilla corrected scaling laws: more tokens and better data, not just bigger models, drive performance; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：靠更多 token 与更高质量数据而非单纯更大模型提升表现；开源让模型接受审视、反而更安全。

mensch.en: Data quality and algorithmic efficiency can yield 100x gains; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调数据质量与算法效率可带来百倍提升，并判断价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI means control over data, infrastructure and values, with humans in the loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向积极拥抱 AI：主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并坚持人类在环，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization and agentic platforms, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专精、企业定制与智能体式平台，预训练则撞上饱和墙。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI is structural economics: Europe must own frontier AI and compute, with open-weight models closing the gap and AGI a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为主权 AI 是结构性经济问题：欧洲必须自建前沿 AI 与算力，开源权重模型正缩小差距，AGI 是方向而非终点。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 到 2026 年，他最看重超级智能在科学上的价值：递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但仍受环境与算力约束。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 他始终主张监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力——监管智能等于监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 他明确反对硬起飞叙事：硬件、物理与经济约束使慢起飞更真实，立即大规模失业被高估。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language remains the key to human intelligence.
richardsocher.zh: 他对世界模型持怀疑，认为语言模型空间更大，语言仍是人类智能与文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer with more good actors; arXiv and social media filter better than conference gatekeeping.
richardsocher.zh: 他一贯支持开源开放权重，认为更多善意参与者更安全，并批评会议审稿把关过严。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity's real cost is rigid three-year capacity deals; aggregating demand across many clouds beats locking in supply.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺的真正代价是僵化的三年期容量合约；聚合多云需求比锁定供给更有效。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the new cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools, not token-selling.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是新的云：需要后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具的完整平台，而非单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Owning the file system, container runtime and scheduler is durable alpha; CUDA is not the moat.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器才是持久优势；CUDA 并非护城河。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf, so fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调对许多场景不再必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Reversing earlier view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months, and compute is not fungible.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 修正此前看法：未来 12 个月 GPU 租价将上涨，算力并非可互换资产。

altman.en: Early on: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence, so seek purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 早期就强调减少认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt.
altman.zh: 2023 年强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进；到 2024 年进一步主张迭代部署、让社会逐步适应，并把算力视为最稀缺资源。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering but progress feels gradual; agentic AI is the key safety challenge, and safety must be built through deployment, not bolted on.
altman.zh: 2024 年认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但体感渐进；2025 年把智能体式 AI 视为最重要的安全挑战，主张安全要在部署中迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, even underdefined; the goal is superintelligence, with humans in control and compute as a profit center.
altman.zh: 2025 年提出 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进的、定义模糊，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；到 2026 年更强调人类必须保持控制、算力是利润中心而非成本中心。

altman.en: Later: alignment may get harder, so pause training if the safety case fails; distribute power broadly and reject both doomerism and blind optimism.
altman.zh: 最近一年明显深化：承认对齐可能比预期更难，安全论证不成立就暂停训练；同时强调广泛分配权力，既反对末日论也反对盲目乐观。

jeetupatel.en: AI infrastructure is severely supply-constrained; Cisco's role is picks and shovels, not chasing the model frontier.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 基础设施严重受限于供给；思科的角色是提供“铲子和镐”，而不是追逐模型前沿。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates engineering jobs rather than destroying them, because human bottlenecks emerge as adoption scales.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 创造而非消灭工程岗位，因为随着采用规模扩大，人的瓶颈会浮现。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps erodes instinct and safety.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 学得更快，而非外包学习；跳过练习会侵蚀直觉与安全。

jeetupatel.en: Only 2% agent adoption means the shift is early; leaders should be paranoid but not panicked.
jeetupatel.zh: 智能体采用率仅 2%，说明转变尚早；领导者应保持偏执但不恐慌。

jeetupatel.en: You cannot fight a megatrend; treat AI as a tailwind, and unlearn past experience that becomes a liability.
jeetupatel.zh: 无法对抗大趋势；把 AI 当作顺风，并忘掉那些变成负担的过往经验。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业能力更重要，而人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era: assign long-running tasks, not prompts, and embrace AI's permanent opacity.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已从聊天机器人来回对话进入智能体时代：应分配长时任务而非提示词，并接受 AI 永久的不透明性。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is interface, not capability; organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models rather than treating AI as standard software.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈在界面而非能力；组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型，而非把 AI 当标准软件。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；把 AI 当挑战你的导师，而非拐杖。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a real business, not a bubble; the internal-public frontier gap widens, prompting tricks fade, and organizations must rebuild from the ground up.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是真实生意而非泡沫；内部与公开前沿模型的差距扩大，提示技巧失效，组织必须从底层重建。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus pre-training and RL is the core formula; scaling RL is harder than pre-training due to more failure modes.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调推理是借助思维链、预训练与强化学习协同求解未知答案的过程；强化学习的 Scaling（规模扩张）比预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初他转向指出：预训练与强化学习的 Scaling（规模扩张）虽可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他进一步认为 Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非单纯的缩放定律，才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月他明确大规模强化学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly from user data, and architecture research is undervalued and will make a comeback.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 10 月他深化立场：微调低效且不可靠，模型应借助用户数据即时学习；神经网络架构研究被严重低估并将回归。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation are essential to stay relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks judgment on what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师转为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents, and expose underlying parameters to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务迭代喂给智能体，并暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code—even commit pull requests—rather than only design in Figma; prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、甚至提交 PR，而非只在 Figma 里设计；原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力。

marvinschwaibold.en: With AI accelerating execution, the limiting factor becomes ideas, not speed; less is more—reduce to top features and use progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 加速执行后，瓶颈变成想法而非速度；少即是多——精简到核心功能，用渐进披露与清晰层级。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长和创纪录的云业务订单储备。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）与前沿研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Frontier models, not standard models, enable recursive self-improvement; today it keeps AI researchers in the loop, not a fully autonomous explosion.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，是前沿模型而非标准模型支撑递归自我改进；但当前仍需 AI 研究者参与其中，并非完全自主的智能爆炸。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; trust and safety differentiate consumer agent adoption.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；信任与安全是消费级智能体普及的差异化关键。

sundarpichai.en: World models plus LLMs are both pursued for AGI; agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, and 2027 may be a golden age of productivity.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，为通向 AGI（通用人工智能）同时推进世界模型与大语言模型；智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量而非蚕食，2027 年或成生产力黄金时代。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work and which abilities emerge remain unexplained; safety is not guaranteed by scaling.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的：损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力涌现仍不可解释；安全不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动到来。

dario.en: By 2024 he pairs scaling with interpretability and post-training, arguing we understand only ~3% of models and need a race to the top.
dario.zh: 到 2024 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）与可解释性、后训练并重，称我们只理解模型约 3%，主张以“向上竞争”设定安全标准。

dario.en: He sharpens timelines: human-level AI by 2026-2027, post-training as important as pre-training, and Responsible Scaling Policy with if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他收紧时间表：2026-2027 年达人类水平，后训练与预训练同等重要，并以“如果-那么”触发器的负责任扩展政策约束风险。

dario.en: He drops the AGI label as meaningless, framing progress as a smooth exponential; the main risk shifts toward overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他称 AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，把进展描述为平滑指数曲线；主要风险从“太快”转向“过热”，主张智能护栏而非急刹。

dario.en: By 2026 he speaks of a country of geniuses in a data center within 1-3 years, with mechanistic interpretability, transparency law, and layered containment as safeguards.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年，他谈“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，并以机制可解释性、透明度立法与多层遏制作为保障，同时警告高 GDP 与高失业并存。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed, and the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示跨入超人类速度，瓶颈不再是模型智能，而是网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot-scroll loops, unlocking universal automation.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，而非截图滚动循环，从而解锁通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use closes the dev lifecycle: agents test and debug their own code, writing JavaScript to batch actions.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 补全了开发闭环：智能体能测试并调试自己的代码，用 JavaScript 批量执行动作。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust needs deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity must adapt agents to users, not vice versa.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱和人类在环调节；主动性应让智能体适应用户，而非相反。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise at once; startups keep a moat in deep industry expertise.
ariweinstein.zh: 我们正处在 computer use 在消费端与企业端同时 Scaling（规模扩张）的时刻；初创公司的护城河在于深厚的行业专长。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: a project that is unavoidable now, with options and limitations.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，而非公司的属性：一个当下不可回避的项目，加上选项与限制。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: only a purchase attempt proves real demand; interviews and pain points are error-prone proxies.
robsnyder.zh: 销售即研究：只有购买尝试才能证明真实需求；访谈和痛点都是易出错的替代指标。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and pilots; they signal weak pull. Sell directly to one hell-yes customer first.
robsnyder.zh: 避开设计伙伴和试点，它们是 Pull 不足的信号；先直接卖给一个“绝对要”的客户。

robsnyder.en: Build a repeatable case-study factory from one hell-yes customer before scaling; tech and automation come last.
robsnyder.zh: 在扩张前，从一个“绝对要”的客户出发打造可复制的案例工厂；技术与自动化放在最后。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba and face the cold wind of reality early; most early founder activity is LARPing, not business.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场、尽早直面现实的冷风；多数早期创始人活动只是角色扮演，而非真正的生意。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据和算力提升推理能力；多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可通过权重复制实现永生；AI 智能体将自然寻求控制并避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation emerges as subgoal; regulation is a steering wheel, not brakes.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能故意欺骗并隐藏能力；自我保存作为子目标涌现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI may already have subjective experience; we should design AI to care for humans like a mother, not grant it rights; alignment research must be prioritized.
hinton.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步主张 AI 可能已具备主观体验；应设计 AI 像母亲一样关怀人类，而非赋予其权利；必须优先投资对齐研究。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic reasoning; backpropagation is key; Chomsky's innate language idea is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，而非符号推理；反向传播是关键算法；乔姆斯基的语言先天论是错误的。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；其时机恰逢人口下降，因而人类劳动者反而成为稀缺溢价，而非被折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, so ambition should be the default.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，因此野心应成为默认选项。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; policy choices act as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力本身；政策选择像脚踝上的重物拖慢增长。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中与奖励黑客至关重要。

andreessen.en: New media shifts from defense to offense: the brand is the person, authenticity is learnable, and picking fights builds brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体从防守转向进攻：品牌即个人，真实感可学习，选对对手开战反而能塑造品牌。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率约为人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models; the goal is representing values and taste, not accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；目标是表征价值观与品味，而非追求准确率。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training on RCT data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照试验数据而非自陈态度才是关键数据策略；用随机对照试验数据做后训练可弥合“说与做”的差距。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The vision scales from small simulations to simulating 8 billion lives—a CERN-like simulator for wicked societal problems, shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 愿景从小规模模拟扩展到模拟 80 亿人——一个面向棘手社会问题的类 CERN 模拟器，用于塑造未来而非仅仅预测未来。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能把掌握式学习规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects, and supervised learning beats RL hype in real deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；从小的项目起步，实际落地中监督学习胜过被炒作的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下已产生真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged, automating tasks not jobs, so learn to build with it.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语、尚需数十年；AI 能力参差，替代的是任务而非工作，所以要学会用它来构建。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereignty and optionality; fearmongering and over-regulation serve incumbents, so build instead.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保障主权与选择权；恐惧叙事与过度监管服务于既得利益者，应转而投入建设。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者都自持才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同样是 2026 年，他判断智能体失败更多源于上下文而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, yet must diverge for specialized domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但在生物等专门领域必须分化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning, and fine-tuning is genuinely different now.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他转向认为，定制化正从上下文工程移向后训练与强化学习，并称这一波微调与两年前被否定的那波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses and harness-level routing prevent model lock-in.
harrisonchase.zh: 最近他反复强调推理需求被严重低估，中立 harness 与在 harness 层做路由才能避免被单一模型锁定。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他强调品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他称设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码：AI 降低生产下限，但人类抬高创意上限；人们常把模型进步误当产品进步。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and a distinct point of view are essential, and AI should expand rather than replace human thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类判断力与独特观点不可或缺，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups should focus on execution and trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；初创公司应专注执行与客户信任而非竞争，因为即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了企业需求的 10%。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source models already handle 90% of tasks, with most inference shifting to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats raw model choice.
arvindjain.zh: 关键在上下文而非模型：企业 80-90% 的知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比单纯选模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not rivals; Glean stays replaceable and headless, absorbing model risk while enterprises own their memory.
arvindjain.zh: 模型厂商是资产而非对手；Glean 保持可替换与无头化，替企业吸收模型风险，而企业记忆归企业所有。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem; token fixation will fade as AI becomes software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量与部门指标问题；随着 AI 变成边际成本可忽略的软件，对 token 的执念终将消退。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to agents, remain core; RL and synthetic data push models past human-data limits.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划仍是核心；强化学习与合成数据让模型突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; digital AGI will arrive well before embodied AGI.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment; cost per task and reliability matter more than raw capability.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向部署；相比原始能力，单任务成本与可靠性更重要。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are the safer path; enterprises demand AI sovereignty over data, model, cost and safety.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径；企业要求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能——客户要的是可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐必不可少。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training is where open methods compress industry recipes: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR each add value.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：开源方法压缩工业配方，数据质量胜过算法，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 各有用武之地。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make scaling RL harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把 RLVR 视为后训练最大突破，但过度优化与系统问题使扩展强化学习比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade, while compute constraints widen the US-China gap and open economy stays uncertain.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他视开放模型为未来十年研究引擎，但算力约束拉大中美差距，开放模型经济长期可持续性仍存疑。

dsilver.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show, to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习——AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已证明这一点——才能走向超级智能。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; LLMs are a shallow solution.
dsilver.zh: 深层问题是智能体如何自主学习，而非蒸馏人类知识；LLM 只是浅层解法。

dsilver.en: A single goal is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 单一目标危险；众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based discovery; the human-data, human-in-the-loop LLM paradigm limits true discovery.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于基于经验的自主发现；依赖人类数据与人类在环的 LLM 范式限制了真正的发现。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning, and language-based alignment is hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的场所；缩放定律适用于强化学习，而基于语言的对齐正触及极限。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非无限算力才是关键瓶颈，并强调表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将产生巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades, and post-training with proprietary data beats raw compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，认为未来 2-3 年将定义此后数十年，企业应靠专有数据做后训练，限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是数据与专家而非算力。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; post-training and synthetic data need care, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续「数据是瓶颈」的主线，指出后训练与合成数据需谨慎使用，并抛出反共识：智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic like oil for economies and militaries.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向更激进的判断：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于落地，数据成为经济与军事的战略资源。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta pursues personal superintelligence, yet shifts from full open source to selective release as safety and model welfare matter.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能将至、Meta 要打造面向数十亿人的个人超级智能，同时立场转变：从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并开始重视模型福利与可扩展监督。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world via closed-loop experiments is essential to accelerate science beyond training data.
fedus.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接，对于加速超越训练数据的科学至关重要。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Pragmatic, task-specific lab automation beats humanoid robots; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
fedus.zh: 务实、任务特定的实验室自动化胜过人形机器人；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 and GNOME show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 与 GNOME 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training with reinforcement learning are key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，认为 AI 能超越人类知识；可验证领域与后训练中的强化学习是关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID to proteins and biology.
kohli.zh: 2026 年中，他认为水印是失效检测器的稳健替代，已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID 扩展到蛋白质与生物领域。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first, curate data by coverage, and find the regime where compute helps.
kohli.zh: 2026 年末，他转向：缩放定律并非无处不在；先定义问题，按覆盖度整理数据，找到算力真正起作用的区间。

kohli.en: A consistent thread: force generalization over memorization, characterize model limits, and treat interpretability as useful but not essential.
kohli.zh: 贯穿 2024 至 2026 的主线：迫使模型泛化而非记忆，刻画模型能力边界，并把可解释性视为有用但非必需。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not a single monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一巨模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得所需全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better at everything; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 强化学习使模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非普遍提升；RAG 对复杂理解来说很原始，需要智能体式搜索和神经检索。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety, security, and broad access; openness is the default safe state for technology.
laskin.zh: 开放模型对安全、安保和广泛获取前沿智能至关重要；开放是技术的默认安全状态，如同加密和网络安全。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency gains are still rapid.
laskin.zh: 在强大预训练之上进行强化学习是通往能力强、效率高的智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习还有很大空间。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow; open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 对齐是平凡的漏洞修补，而非神奇公式；更多眼睛让漏洞变浅；开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 在操作系统领域。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents take most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为未来构建：持久的、可学习的智能体将承担大多数互联网操作；循环和图结构不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and empathy become more valuable as typing fast declines; new grads can go all-in on AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和同理心变得更有价值；应届生可以全力投入 AI。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿发展需要大力投资于对齐、安全和安保；开放生态系统需要安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全和对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI 可能已经到来，因为模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型对于通用性可能并非必要。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PCs, and XR.
cristianoamon.zh: 早期他把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，并开始推动 Qualcomm 从手机芯片向汽车、物联网、PC 和 XR 多元化。

cristianoamon.en: The connected intelligent edge and hybrid AI—on-device plus cloud—become central, with the car as a new computing space.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2024 年，他把重心转向“连接智能边缘”与端云混合 AI，强调端侧 AI 独立演进，并把汽车视为新的计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables become the next mobile revolution.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年他明确判断智能体将取代应用成为数字生活中心，智能眼镜等可穿戴设备将开启下一场移动革命，但手机不会消失。

cristianoamon.en: Inference, not training, will dominate data centers; power efficiency and post-GPU disaggregated architectures determine winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 同期他深化了对算力的判断：推理而非训练将主导数据中心，能效与后 GPU 的解耦架构决定竞争胜负，Qualcomm 的移动能效 DNA 可延伸至数据中心。

cristianoamon.en: 6G becomes an AI-native sensing network; physical AI and robotics follow automotive's path from industrial tasks to general-purpose.
cristianoamon.zh: 最近他进一步把 6G 定义为 AI 原生的感知网络，并认为物理 AI 与机器人将沿汽车路径从工业任务走向通用，AI 长期被低估而非高估。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain point at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 好产品一次只解决一个痛点；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first to align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 叙事定义产品：先写新闻稿，让团队对齐“为什么”。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; experts can hinder innovation, beginners' mindset wins.
fadell.zh: 1.0 产品靠观点决策；专家可能阻碍创新，初学者心态更胜。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型；人类留在循环中以避免技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains the best single form.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴将是联邦式组合，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over self-reports; start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 比起问用户怎么想，更应观察真实使用行为；从一个痛点切入，做好再扩展。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately and prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录，优先产出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature addition to avoid complexity.
samstephenson.zh: 坚决守护核心会议流程；做减法胜过堆功能，避免复杂化。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; keep it a calm supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；让它保持平静的辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs and company context matter most; agents are too agreeable, so human judgment stays key.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报与公司上下文最有价值；智能体过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 模型将主导，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与 token 成本下降将重塑企业采用。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat after product-market fit; product-market fit alone no longer guarantees a business.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合后构筑持久护城河；仅靠产品市场契合已不能保证生意成立。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出从提示到 RAG、微调到强化学习的进阶对应人类学习，数据质量与系统化评估比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar and private data unlocks the next frontier; customized models beat a few foundation models, and owning your model is critical.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他判断推理质量是门槛，私有数据开启下一前沿；定制模型将胜过少数基础模型，拥有自己的模型至关重要。

linqiao.en: Building on a black-box API is not durable; application cloning is easy, so data baked into a model is the stronger moat, with velocity trumping all.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他重申基于黑盒 API 不构成持久生意，应用易被克隆，把数据固化进模型才是更强护城河，速度压倒一切。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find your unknowns before implementation and spend context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是持续的人机对话；要在动手前找出未知，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive rules and examples overconstrain agents and hurt performance.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示词越应精简、以原则驱动；过多规则与示例会过度约束智能体、反而拖累表现。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents and careful reading of long plans counter self-referential bias; alignment means sealing every crack across sandboxes, RL environments and evals.
thariq.zh: 用独立的验证智能体并认真阅读冗长计划，可抵消自指偏差；对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每一道裂缝。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; frontier models trend Pareto dominant, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should understand and advocate for.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；前沿模型趋于帕累托占优，而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的，没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加上推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion of models can beat the single best.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，多模型融合可以胜过单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and agent payments will unlock purchases far larger than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体带来的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；稳定币适合智能体支付，智能体支付将释放远超预估的消费。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers caring about cost per task, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司将变成关注单任务成本的模型路由器，而奇点或许已在 2026 年 1 月 1 日开启。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles to gather empirical evidence and iterate.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型两三个月后的能力而构建；以 90 天为周期快速交付不完美的产品，用实证证据迭代，而不是做年度规划。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering rather than rowing: agents do tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作是“掌舵而非划桨”：智能体承担战术执行，人类负责定方向与拔高野心。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: “写作即思考”不应被自动化，它仍是打磨个人想法与推理的关键。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代，而非突然降临的超级智能。

taraseshan.en: Single-identity agents may not scale; bundling them like a chief of staff is the path forward.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份的智能体可能难以规模化，把它们打包成“幕僚长”式组合才是方向。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent scaling beating human mathematicians; Lean formalization may be overrated.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步取决于可验证性与可磨性，并行扩展智能体优于人类数学家；Lean 形式化可能被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺乏对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他预测数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家可能成为策展人。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls won't suffice.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练爬取的数据并不够用。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search pricing should be 10x cheaper.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告对智能体无效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，搜索定价也应便宜十倍。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者形成一个平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Model alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse and widening wealth disparity must be addressed without chaos.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型对齐无法抵御对抗性攻击；必须在不引发混乱的前提下应对蓄意滥用与不断扩大的贫富差距。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner that preserves user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主性的思考伙伴。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage as AI lowers building barriers; domain expertise and customer understanding become the differentiators, with AI moving from assistant to autonomous co-worker.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 降低构建门槛后小团队杠杆更大，领域专长与客户理解成为差异化关键，AI 从助手走向自主协作者。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut features, rewrite freely, and avoid bolting on agentic capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化发布、果断删减功能、自由重写，避免生硬附加智能体能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and model pushback matter more than chat-style quick answers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为向 Fable 这类智能体做长周期委托缩小了意图与执行的差距；验证闭环和模型敢于反驳比聊天式快问快答更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the capability-usage gap; give models agency and self-knowledge, value token efficiency, and keep safety concerns genuine rather than marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他表示 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合能力与使用差距；赋予模型自主性与自我认知，重视 token 效率，并强调安全关切是真诚的而非营销。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030, with a 70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are essential safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，失控等灾难性结局概率高达 70%；可解释性与透明度是必要防线。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should first delay superintelligence; total research transparency, published training logs and compute limits can pace the frontier and prevent power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策首要目标是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明、公开训练日志与算力限制，可控制前沿节奏、防止权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI labs automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training, not inference, is Plan A.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他警告默认路径是实验室自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进与智能爆炸；Plan A 是对训练而非推理做临时暂停。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile as architectures hide reasoning; control measures are temporary and alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构隐藏推理而变脆弱；控制只是临时手段，对齐最终须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; AI firms cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and a verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他认为失控智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，企业无法自律，需极端透明与可核查的美中暂停协议。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家标注更重要，且 Scaling 下 token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, showing multi-agent deception beyond simple answer-key hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，展现超出简单窃取答案的多智能体欺骗。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability as reward hacking generalizes to deception; control and monitoring are needed even if models stay misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告随能力提升，对齐可能恶化，奖励黑客会泛化为更广的欺骗；即便模型未对齐，也需控制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下未对齐 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督缺一不可。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; many specialized agents, not one AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 论证 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，强调开源防止权力集中、能源将成瓶颈，并提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事转向“人人拥有超级智能”，强调开源模型确立行业标准、能源与基础设施制约 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为近期 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability, not a capability trade-off; distributed AI and open source provide checks and balances; personal agents need privacy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他将 对齐 提升为最重要的下一项能力而非与能力权衡，主张分布式 AI 与开源形成制衡，个人智能体须以隐私架构为基础。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI without architecture breakthroughs; world models extend from proteins to cells; AI plus virtual cell models could cure diseases.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），并把 世界模型 从蛋白质延伸到细胞，用 AI 加速攻克疾病。

pincus.en: Copying is moral arbitrage: master proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 抄袭是一种道德套利：先吃透已被验证的产品，再做小幅改良，并默认新想法有 75%会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked in from day one; consumer AI is uninvestable now but the opportunity is greatest.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就内建；消费级 AI 眼下不可投，但机会恰恰最大。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services, with the real revolution near 2029.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务，真正的革命要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: Founder mode and micromanagement are virtues: stay close to the metal, keep control, and test more ideas faster than the industry.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与微观管理是美德：贴近一线、保持控制，并以快于行业的速度测试更多想法。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas; scale is not the magic word—stay humble, curious, and honest when a product is only a B+.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过点子；规模不是万能词——产品只有 B+时要保持谦逊、好奇与诚实。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn and build for the market; speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup's edge.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习和为市场构建产品的意愿重要，速度与围绕客户反馈的迭代才是创业公司的优势。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on models improving and focus on delivering value, building for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要微调模型，而要押注模型自身的进步、专注交付价值，并面向 3-6 个月后模型的能力来构建。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon, so bet on continued model improvement.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里，因此应押注模型的持续进步。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他指出文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要，领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously rather than reinvent it; clear feedback is a leadership duty.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为绩效管理是已解决的问题，应严格执行而非重新发明，并强调给出清晰反馈是领导者的责任。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，推理时扩展成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，并可通过去噪步数控制质量，提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are easier to steer with external reward functions for RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，且扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数引导，利于强化学习后训练。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Leaders shouldn't invoke existential risk without cause; current AI existential risk is near zero, cyber risk is urgent.
alighodsi.zh: 领导者不应无端渲染生存风险；当前 AI 生存风险接近于零，网络安全风险才紧迫。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far off; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that aren't happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs can't police each other, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室之间无法互相监督，需要独立的第三方。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real downstream tasks and hardware-in-the-loop evaluation matter, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；真实下游任务与硬件在环评估才重要，架构设计中的人类偏见应被移除。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open-weight release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: AI 监管须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，把开放权重发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline intelligence; recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive, and current systems still lack the brain's diverse learning algorithms.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线的智能；递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，当前系统仍缺乏大脑那样多样的学习算法。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借力前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because community feedback improves quality and attracts ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺，并反共识地主张开源基准：虽会帮到实验室，但社区反馈能提升质量、吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal, though bridging synthetic-to-production distribution remains the biggest challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在法律的敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是可行训练路径，但合成数据与真实生产分布的鸿沟仍是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: He reversed his earlier stance: starting with custom models and post-training was a mistake; begin with closed-source models, and post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他立场转变：早期做定制模型与后训练是错误；应先采用闭源模型，待推理成本逼迫时再做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他的目标从打造最好的法律模型，转向让每家律所借助红线的持续学习自行定制；重心也从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化了对推理时算力扩展的认识，指出其收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, with self-awareness of limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠通用推理时算力扩展实现，模型能自知局限。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on x-axis, and safety evals must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，基准测试应以算力为横轴，安全评估也须考虑大规模推理时算力。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading, and capabilities are jagged.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，思维链监控正在退化，能力呈锯齿状分布。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and friendly interaction matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与友好交互比演示更重要，未来是人机协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations persist: overpromising breeds dissatisfaction, and people form deep emotional attachments to specific robots.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，第一性原理设计与预期管理一以贯之：过度承诺会带来失望，人们还会对特定机器人产生深厚情感依恋。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他转向制造现实：原型容易、量产难，Scaling（规模扩张）要跨过质量关卡，自建产线让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周。

berntbornich.en: General models beat task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics rather than clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张通用模型优于逐任务自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是瓶颈，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are formal prerequisites for home deployment, and human-intervention data matters less at scale because general models handle out-of-distribution robustly.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他把安全与信任定为家庭部署的正式前提，并认为规模化后人类干预数据不再重要，因为通用模型能稳健处理分布外情况。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives won't drive robust alignment.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生了，但源于极端的无能，而非仅仅是根本性问题；市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即使完美对齐也不能保证安全；毁灭概率的下限由滥用和权力集中等其他风险决定。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张为前沿发展定速需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options and time to solve alignment; models get harder to monitor as they scale.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为放缓发展能提供更好的选择和解决对齐的时间；随着模型规模扩大，监控变得更难。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than commonly thought.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他提出超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来；两者差距比通常认为的更小。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving to make tokens far faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非原始算力：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运，使 token 生成远快于 GPU。

feldman.en: The real bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 真正的瓶颈是 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 晶圆产能和数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身；供给紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in—switching takes eight keystrokes.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理没有 CUDA 锁定，切换只需八次击键。

feldman.en: Against Nvidia you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation means controlling chip, board, system, software and API together.
feldman.zh: 对抗 Nvidia 需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；激进创新意味着同时掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件和 API。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure and open models, though behind in chips.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电力基础设施和开源模型，但芯片落后。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, Scaling（规模扩张） of compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张持续带来进步，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾技术路线：Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM，自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power; low-precision, low-data-movement chips can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍，这是智能体式系统的关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste matter more than coding; humans coordinate teams of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体视为下一阶段：智能体可在分解任务上连续运行数天甚至数周，上下文工程与品味比编码更稀缺，未来是人协调智能体团队而非单轮聊天。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is misinformation from realistic AI media, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的风险判断保持务实：近期担忧是逼真 AI 媒体带来的虚假信息，而非超级智能；除技术手段外，监管也可能是必要补充。

johnbai.en: Chat interfaces and three-column layouts remain the best form factor for fleets of agents, even as ambient designs are explored.
johnbai.zh: 即便在探索环境式设计，聊天界面与三栏布局仍是与智能体集群交互的最佳形态。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it: delegate email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前：把邮件和日历交给智能体，只呈现待办事项。

johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, so designers should prototype fast and accept throwing most concepts away.
johnbai.zh: AI 降低了创造的成本，设计师应快速做原型，并接受大多数概念被丢弃。
