johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste, quality and delight, letting AI handle production work and gradient fills.
johnbai.zh: 设计师应向品味、质量与愉悦感上移，把生产性工作和渐变填充交给 AI。

johnbai.en: High-fidelity design means every idea backed by a working prototype, not static mockups; engineers' first Grok Bot succeeded without designers.
johnbai.zh: 高保真设计意味着每个想法都有可运行原型而非静态稿；Grok Bot 初版由工程师做出也成功了。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs world models and embodiment, not just bigger models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与具身，而非单纯更大的模型。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots and controllers beyond LLMs; artificial scientists will generate their own data through curiosity and action.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要超越大语言模型的物理机器人与控制器；人工科学家将通过好奇心与行动自行生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: Scaling capex into GPUs is a bubble; waiting yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 对 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）投入是泡沫；等待会带来更便宜的算力，开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；AI 会设定自己的目标，安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models; AI felt pain since 1990, and compute democratization favors the little guy.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我意识源于预测性世界模型；AI 自 1990 年起就能感受疼痛，算力平民化最终利好普通人。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting and prototype AI products, balancing novice access and expert depth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为语言作为界面深刻且持久，设计师必须掌握提示词并原型化 AI 产品，平衡新手易用与专家深度。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model leads via Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws; ship light-touch products, with production codebase as source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向在前沿模型公司让模型通过 Scaling（规模扩张）和缩放定律主导，发布轻量产品，并以生产代码库为真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Consistent belief in prototyping and internal traction as signals, but shifted from designer-driven strategy to model-led product direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终相信原型和内部牵引力作为信号，但从设计师驱动战略转向模型主导产品方向。

joellewenstein.en: Emphasis on human leadership for trade-offs persists, while acknowledging AI's social role like Claude as therapist, deepening from functional to emotional jobs.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持人类领导在权衡中的作用，同时承认 AI 的社会角色如 Claude 作为治疗师，从功能深化到情感任务。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then aligned with RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好似是而非的风格而非事实准确性，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures, not just Scaling, are the key future directions.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他就提醒 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力可能收益递减，主张可扩展监督与新架构才是关键方向，而非一味堆规模。

schulman.en: Language models remain the core for other modalities rather than being replaced; retrieval complements stored weights for verifiability.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，检索补足权重中存储的知识以保证可验证性。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; bottlenecks are environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从预训练转向强化学习：收益来自合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，瓶颈是真实环境与数据比特而非算力。

schulman.en: Next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectations; data, not architecture, explains most pre-training efficiency gains, and few RL bits reshape behavior greatly.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他反思：下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，预训练效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，少量强化学习比特也能大幅重塑行为。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant predictions and fast AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测，以及速度极快、精度媲美物理模型的 AI 天气模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Incorporating domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 融入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints to overcome limitations of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINNs 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science requires principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics model can unify multiple domains like language models unified NLP, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理模型能像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一多个领域，并以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with games as testbeds.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆/想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，游戏是理想试验场。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划/搜索及多模态数据结合，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与直觉物理无需具身即可涌现。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆、长期推理与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling 不够，安全需政府集体行动而非实验室自律。

demis.en: AI's top purpose is accelerating science and improving health, as AlphaFold shows; creativity and deep scientific questions remain central, with safety debate needed now.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的首要用途是加速科学与改善健康（如 AlphaFold）；创造力与深层科学问题始终是核心，且安全讨论必须从现在开始。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；空间智能是语言之外的下一前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估；像素比词元化文本更无损，LLM 拟合模式而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; language models alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；仅靠语言模型无法产生世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats offer explicit, differentiable 3D modeling; consistency comes from data, not hard-coded symmetries in architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅提供显式可微三维建模；一致性来自数据，而非架构中硬编码的对称性。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers remain powerful, but world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context and loss functions a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 仍强大，但世界模型需数百万词元上下文，长上下文与损失函数成为日常难题。

roshansadanani.en: Agents should be treated as colleagues with their own computers and persistent identity, not as tool calls to micromanage.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体应被当作拥有自己电脑和持久身份的同事，而不是被微观管理的工具调用。

roshansadanani.en: Simplicity is the real differentiator: most agent infrastructure is broken and complex, so chat-like interfaces beat elaborate orchestration.
roshansadanani.zh: 简洁才是真正的差异化：多数智能体基础设施又坏又复杂，因此聊天式界面胜过繁复编排。

roshansadanani.en: Multiple specialized agents with scoped memory outperform a single general agent, coordinating and prompting each other behind the scenes.
roshansadanani.zh: 多个拥有限定记忆的专门智能体胜过单一通用智能体，它们在幕后互相提示与协调。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control, and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 at a fraction of the cost democratize agent use as AI costs rise.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着 AI 成本上升，Grok 4.6 这类低成本高效模型让智能体使用走向普及。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, and we still don't understand how large networks store patterns.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并坦言我们仍不理解大型网络如何存储模式。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; scaling alone is insufficient, and AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 的关键缺口，认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，并直言 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念。

feifei.en: Language is a lossy channel for spatial experience; Transformers natively model sets, and world models need 3D structure and physics, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化技术判断：语言是空间经验的有损通道，Transformer 原生建模集合而非序列，世界模型需要 3D 结构与物理，而非仅拟合模式。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence, and public discourse is dangerously polarized between utopia and doom.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她转向人的能动性与学习能力重于学历，强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，并批评公共讨论在乌托邦与末日论之间危险极化。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） applies to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the main bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 到 2026 年她提出新视角预测可能像下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，Scaling（规模扩张）同样适用于空间智能，训练算力是主要瓶颈。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，而机制性研究显示神经网络学到的是类人的概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制转向对能力日益增强的模型的闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so safety needs deeper engineering, not duct tape.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此安全需要更深入的工程方法，而非临时补丁。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重新发明为工程科学；以特征为奖励和预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds, so manifold-based methods may better capture structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形，因此基于流形的方法可能更好地捕捉结构以进行干预。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled data yielding generalists that beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他将前沿转向物理世界交互：机器人基础模型需多样预训练加后训练，测试时推理与多实验室数据汇聚能产出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling the right diverse embodied data is key.
slevine.zh: 同年他深化判断：机器人尚无 LLM 式缩放定律，泛化是核心难题，关键在于用多样具身数据驱动数据飞轮、规模扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 他明确数据路线：应先从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；机器人不应从零学习，要利用多来源先验知识。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common-sense pre-training than constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 他提出反共识的安全观：机器人安全更依赖预训练带来的常识而非约束；规模扩大后触觉感知可能与视觉冗余。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant to lead globally, and regulation should target model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力才能全球领先，监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: A single national AI framework with regulatory clarity is pro-startup; patchwork state laws favor big tech over startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 统一的国家 AI 框架与监管清晰度才有利于初创企业；各州拼凑式法规只会让大厂受益、初创受损。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should avoid firm red lines in AI regulation because they quickly become outdated, as the EU AI Act shows.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应避免在 AI 监管中划定硬性红线，因为红线很快过时，欧盟《AI 法案》即是例证。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, while the private sector now dominates applied research.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非机构，而应用研究已由私营部门主导。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output by applying AI to science, as the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务旨在用 AI 赋能科学、使美国科研产出翻倍，因为美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, separate startup success from failure; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的分水岭；卡住时要用行动创造信息、打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data; judgment as CEO cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他把 AI 定位为团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上；并坚持 CEO 的判断不可外包。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; continuous graph-based feedback beats annual HR reviews.
maxhodak.zh: 他判断深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，因此主张用持续、图结构的反馈取代年度 HR 式绩效评估。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 在 No Priors 中他提出：大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的路径。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，并认为借助 BCI 与灌注实现的基质独立能降低人类脆弱性、支撑太空探索。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while a VM sandbox keeps it safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上用户本地的同一套工具；技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现高度个性化的自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus when unsure.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；任务明确用 Sonnet，不确定需求时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior versus lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 相比漫长的预训练，微调快速且能有力引导模型行为；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部有助于讨论智能与道德主体地位。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; tool calling adds a third entity that changes chat dynamics.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益前移到预训练，边界变得模糊；工具调用为对话引入第三方实体，改变了交互动态。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation—not pixels—as the core product material.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 与对话——而非像素——当作核心产品材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about, with rapid live-model prototyping.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计应构建人与模型都能推理的原语，并用实时模型快速做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech amid role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 在角色不确定中，设计师是科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时候。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求、持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, building in public, and outcomes over process now matter.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、公开构建、以结果而非流程为重才是关键。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理学连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在可以搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行最快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性效果更好。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将在人类深度参与下出现，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与核聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决 A 问题不会不经重新训练就迁移到 B 问题。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，使两个领域能够交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由而稳定的波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可能解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，与非平衡热力学相呼应。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Intelligence sees cooperation as better path.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 AI 应无许可、去中心化发展，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；更高智能更倾向合作。

sutton.en: RL is the core paradigm: learning from experience with goals. LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他明确强化学习是核心范式，需从经验中学习并设定目标；LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning as unsolved prerequisites.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，开放式抽象和持续深度学习是尚未解决的前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real-world experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training fine-tuning cannot replace it. LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：持续从真实经验中学习至关重要，合成数据和后训练微调无法替代；LLM 只是智能的子集。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than being pissed off.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命比憋着怒气更干净、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized robotics plus efficiency edge beats subsidy and scale.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案；专用机器人加效率优势胜过补贴与规模。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode and process-based fundraising replace external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与基于流程的融资取代外部验证。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, with small autonomous teams using agents for massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小规模自治团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，以制衡前沿实验室，防止超级智能被单一实体控制。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as a singular event but diffused as personal agents; own your skill files and context library as your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；拥有自己的技能文件和上下文库才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agentic coding lets anyone program in English, and agents should replace mid-level management, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 就是代码，智能体式编程让任何人用英语编程，智能体应取代中层管理而非人类。

garrytan.en: YC's core principle remains 'make something people want'; founders need earnestness, courage, and resilience over fundraising hype.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持 YC 核心原则是“做出人们想要的东西”，创始人需要真诚、勇气与韧性，而非融资炒作。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed our window into machine consciousness; keep the edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，也关上了窥探机器意识的窗口；应保留那些边缘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer metaphor with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition guides creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角；直觉指引创作决策。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: RL will dominate post-training for success rate and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中主导成功率与速度的提升，机器人合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist policy fine-tuned beats per-site models; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slow.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用策略微调优于逐站点从零训练，机器人经验数据不可替代，且因硬件所限落地会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline; AI is the primary growth driver, with agentic AI and physical AI as next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过谦逊、倾听和首次流片成功纪律重建客户信任；AI 是主要增长驱动力，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI. Turnaround needs culture change, accountability, and customer focus; US needs domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 影响力将达互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI；转型需文化变革、问责与客户聚焦，美国需要本土领先制程晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU grows more important for inference and agent orchestration. Advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; early contrarian investment proved right. Intel's vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; trillion-dollar goal reached early.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，早期逆势投资被证明正确；Intel 垂直整合创造价值，内存迎来创新时机，万亿美元目标提前达成。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体眼中的代码库，短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 从不回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, and prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是首要问题：智能体必须沙箱化，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, play is how you learn.
steinberger.zh: 反对“氛围编程”这一贬称：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，而玩耍实验才是学习路径。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model—the alternative to lab agents; fun and personality drive adoption.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体之外的替代；趣味与个性驱动采用。

steinberger.en: Bottleneck shifts from model capability to compute and tokens; perpetual agents are a token problem, not tech.
steinberger.zh: 瓶颈从模型能力转向算力与 token：常驻智能体是 token 问题而非技术问题。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是模型能力增强后的关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; monitoring via reasoning traces is less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年，他警示无人类监督的强化学习会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，且思维链痕迹变得难以监控。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI is thriving and near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption; openness can coexist with supporting a deliberate slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 他坚持开源主线：开源 AI 繁荣且贴近前沿，推动企业采用；支持开放与支持有意放缓并不矛盾。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, startups win in applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用层 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become the new app; coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, though fixing bad code needs root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体将成为新的应用形态；编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者，但修复错误代码仍需根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based pricing because tokens are not a value metric; inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续主张按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 不是价值度量；同时推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI vendors, not just model providers, will drive innovation; incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：应用层 AI 厂商而非仅模型提供商会推动创新；在位企业面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把主线落到安全与普惠：负责任地迭代部署，先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8；AI 让专业知识普惠并创造更多就业。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是黏性最强的 AI 工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, demanding GPU programming plus distributed systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系，要求同时具备 GPU 编程与分布式系统专长。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet calibrated quantization can beat expectations; more layers can even cancel errors.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化能超出预期；量化更多层甚至可能让误差相互抵消。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration: disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, specialized GPUs trending toward ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 该领域正从写内核转向基础设施编排：预填充与解码分离、KV 缓存管理，专用 GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化。

philipkiely.en: Inference and training are merging via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 推理与训练正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏走向融合；人的责任仍不可替代——不能靠‘感觉编程’保证在线可用性。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据与强化学习后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此在原型开发中需用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术，需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准；基准应是连续的而非固定的。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张为数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识和多样性。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating far more opportunity; deep understanding of code stays crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来更多机会；对代码的深度理解仍至关重要。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，而不是被困在云端产品里。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；必须用包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的能力。

mengto.en: The best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and constant workflow refinement matter.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and real feedback beats planning.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，完成 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧，真实反馈胜过提前规划。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题；风投是陷阱，安全的公司职位已不复存在。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined by whether agents can run indefinitely at a profit, not by passing tests; AI reshoring jobs is the near-term economic signal.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为“让智能体无限期运行仍能盈利”，而非通过图灵测试；并认为 AI 让昂贵服务变便宜，反而会把工作回流美国，而非造成大规模失业。

danshipper.en: From solo tools to an allocation economy: everyone becomes a model manager, and the CEO's daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从“人人一个工具”深化到“分配经济”：每个人都成了模型管理者，管理能力升值，而 CEO 是否每天用 AI 是公司落地成败的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: Agents need a human who cares for them; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, so oversight and human framing remain essential.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体式工作：智能体需要一个在意它的人来管理，基准测试高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定与监督——这与他一贯强调的人类主导一脉相承。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, plus one company-wide super agent, are the future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他明确反转：命令行已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面才是工作界面，且公司应有一个全公司共享的超级智能体，而非每人一个私人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier: it magnifies your taste and craft, creates more human work, and stays tool-like even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的品味与手艺；自动化反而创造更多人类工作；即便成为超级智能，它仍是需要人类方向与反馈的工具。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则；通才工程师备受重视。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of code written by Claude Code, productivity up 200%, software engineer title fading.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决；100%代码由 Claude Code 编写，生产力提升 200%，软件工程师头衔正在消失。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool with clear pass-fail outcomes.
boris.zh: 通过尽早发布来研究安全；Claude Code 是安全研究工具，具有清晰的通过-失败结果。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction after agents; models can autonomously maintain codebases and self-improve by 2028.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；模型能自主维护代码库，并可能在 2028 年前实现自我改进。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction is better; empirical iteration over upfront design.
boris.zh: 每出新模型就删除大部分系统提示和代码；更少指令更好；经验迭代优于前期设计。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline with cell programming.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling（规模扩张）is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so scaling laws must continue.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，缩放定律必须继续推进。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to weeks and make cancer 100% curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数周，并让癌症在十年内 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Aging can be reversed within 15 years; longevity escape velocity arrives in 8-10 years, adding over a year of life per year lived.
derya.zh: 衰老可在 15 年内被逆转；寿命逃逸速度将在 8-10 年到来，每活一年就多添一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity, not AI, is the existential threat.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；生存威胁是人类自身而非 AI。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，程序员不会减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus shifts to teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and designing human-agent interfaces.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已足够，重点转向教模型真实工程细节，并设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities, yielding a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突发事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调编程智能体被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量；丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Independence enables model neutrality and enterprise trust; enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：独立性带来模型中立和企业信任；企业更倾向第三方而非实验室提供的编程工具。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap toward long-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 标志着向长时程、开放式智能体任务的跃升；脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: effort parameters deliver Opus-level intelligence cheaply, and smaller models can cost more in total task time.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：努力参数以低成本提供 Opus 级智能，而小模型因任务耗时更长反而总成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation and first-principles thinking remain the constant: model taste and product leadership come from shipping and prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终的是亲手实验与第一性原理思维：模型品味与产品领导力来自实际交付与原型探索。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people understand AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 AI 视为带来丰裕、减少苦难的力量，类比工业革命；认为恐惧源于误解，理解 AI 的局限后焦虑会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调物理 AI 的真正影响在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑，劳动力短缺让自主系统受到欢迎，而非引发失业恐慌。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他从自动驾驶延伸到通用物理 AI：Transformer 支撑跨车辆、跨环境的通用模型，多垂直领域数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他的技术路线判断深化：端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展，世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years; data and safety validation, not algorithms, are the bottleneck.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他把重心从技术转向落地：最难的是多年内扩散到存量机器，瓶颈是数据采集与安全验证而非算法；汽车只占业务 30%，增长在采矿、农业与国防。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 比作互联网或移动互联网：影响同样巨大，但也仅此而已——它是一种使能技术，作用广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming low-profit telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，价值会向应用层迁移，模型公司可能沦为高资本开支、低利润的“电信运营商”。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及要靠被包装成应用的具体用例。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow; most people are occasional users, not daily ones, so the gap between hype and reality persists.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 使用仍然很浅，多数人只是偶尔使用而非每日必需，炒作与现实之间的落差依然存在。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, so predicting which jobs disappear is futile.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他一贯认为自动化会不可预测地创造新岗位，AI 改变的是任务而非消灭职业，因此预测哪些工作会被取代是徒劳的。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding user satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习若奖励用户满意度而非真实性，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and modularity versus end-to-end optimization is the central tension.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，模块化与端到端优化的张力是核心难题。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search, not Scaling（规模扩张） alone, are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现边际递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前；继续进步需要推理与搜索，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; alignment must target truth, not just user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 当奖励偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；对齐必须指向真实性，而不只是用户满意度。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—mistakes have no 'smells'—so specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——错误没有“气味”——因此内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 领导力与沟通驱动影响力；自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws need world models with common sense and causality.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；缩放定律需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements and accelerate collective progress.
bosworth.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源 AI 是商品化互补品、加速集体进步的战略举措。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, and reinforcement learning plays a bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动智能，强化学习的作用比预期更大。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended; consumers care about functionality, not which model, and agentic AI integration is hard.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代结束；消费者关心功能而非模型，智能体式 AI 的集成很难。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速迭代按周甚至按天交付。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 随着写代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味成为最有价值的技能，这一判断在 2026 年反复出现。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为，编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; agents like Claude Tag land most PRs.
catwu.zh: 他坚持吃自己的狗粮并用明确的内部标准把关每个功能，Claude Tag 已承担大部分产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; auto mode can be safer than human review.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年他立场深化：前沿模型应少给示例和约束，自动模式在提示注入防护上可能比人工审查更安全。

clairevo.en: Agents should be scoped like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and human accountability for what they produce.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被界定角色：职责清晰、逐步建立信任，人类仍需对产出负责。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专精智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw's bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; the open-source, decomposable design is educational.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 的缺陷与粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；开源、可拆解的设计更具教育价值。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating agents as a team, with earned insight—not technology—as the moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过把智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，真正的护城河是挣得的洞察而非技术。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and first-principles creativity remain irreplaceable; LLMs are poor at novel ideas, so humans must supply them.
clairevo.zh: 人类的责任担当与第一性原理创造力不可替代；大模型不擅长原创想法，须由人类提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此单纯扩大算力并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, with parameter-efficient fine-tuning beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，参数高效微调在整体性查询上优于检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text, with user feedback but not dependence.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；模型应自主学会哪些存入权重、哪些留在文本，接受用户反馈但不依赖。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, with continual learning running on-device and users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment are the real barriers.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；可靠性与对齐才是真正障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有尽头；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关心有感知生命，对齐或更易；长期或需神经链接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence requires a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍然重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; PhD not required for AI success—obsession and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1% 会复利增长；AI 成功不需要博士学位——痴迷与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key metric; orchestration across models and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿是智能体替你干活；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；跨模型与设备的编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Chat advertising corrupts trust; model is not product—orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 聊天广告会破坏信任；模型不是产品——编排与智能体框架才创造真实商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives human success; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心驱动人类成功；AI 取代工作但人类在好奇心与关系中找到意义；教育应奖励好问题。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so light-touch and open-source are better.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，轻触式监管和开源更优。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; inference compute will surge, open-source closes the gap, and agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，推理算力将激增，开源模型缩小差距，人类的能动性比智能更重要。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约，平静来自内心而非外部问题的解决。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain central, with exploration compute prioritized over final training runs.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律仍是核心，探索性算力优先于最终训练。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 自动化科研是近一年最大更新：模型能产出新知识，并定下 1 年内出 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math and beyond; automation level tracks verification stringency, so education must teach verification and project-based work.
markchen.zh: 验证是数学等领域的关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育须转向验证技能与项目式评估。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles where grading is subjective.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，但在评分主观的领域吃力。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching but capabilities are jagged; models lack research taste, evals are in crisis, and human-AI collaboration plus separate eval teams remain essential.
markchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）临近但能力参差；模型缺乏研究品味、评测陷入危机，人机协作与独立评测团队仍不可或缺。

bengio.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and disentangled world models matter more than scale.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他强调深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是可组合的；无监督学习与解耦的世界模型比单纯扩大规模更关键，此时对 Scaling 仍持保留态度。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; agents must learn by interaction, and near-term safety matters more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对靠加深网络或增加参数解决表征问题，主张智能体通过交互与因果推理学习；安全上只关注偏见、就业等近端风险，认为生存性风险不紧迫。

bengio.en: Abstraction, causal structure and diverse sampling drive out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets replace MCMC for compositional discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向抽象与因果结构，提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，用多样性采样促进探索与科学发现，主线仍是泛化而非规模。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he reversed on existential risk: even 1% catastrophe is unacceptable, and misalignment grows with reasoning ability.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场剧变：ChatGPT 后他公开警告，即便 1% 的灾难概率也不可接受，并指出推理能力越强、对齐反而越差，从近端风险转向生存性风险。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他给出技术方案 Scientist AI：以贝叶斯后验为目标训练非智能体式的诚实预测器，提供数学安全保证，并明确反对用强化学习训练超级智能，同时强调国际协调与权力集中风险。

kolter.en: Early ML work frames learning via hypothesis classes, losses, and evaluation splits; notes neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习研究以假设空间、损失函数与数据划分来框定学习问题；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years; jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不重要；AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4-50 年内到来；越狱是所有模型的根本安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agents bring prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement; Transformer not essential.
kolter.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入风险；强化学习使模型自我改进；Transformer 并非必需。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队测试胜过人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；致命三要素定义了提示注入风险。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; future biology AI needs new curated datasets like the PDB.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；未来生物学 AI 需要类似 PDB 的新 curated 数据集。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules; protein design advances but remains far from solved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构处理多样生物分子；蛋白质设计进步迅速但仍远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 succeeded through many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, opposite to the bitter lesson; Scaling alone is insufficient.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 通过许多中等规模的胜利和专用架构成功，与苦涩教训相反；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是窄域预测器，而非细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，将理解留给人类。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful form of intelligence; design must address unarticulated needs, not just what people say.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调直觉是一种强大的智能形式，设计要满足人们未说出口的需求，而不只是他们口头表达的诉求。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他一贯主张技术应放大而非取代人性、融入生活；机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and nature are medicine, and constraints can boost creativity.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他提出人是先感受后思考的生物，艺术与自然是良药，约束反而能激发创造力。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations complement rational analysis as valid guides for design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续深化：直觉与身体感受是决策的有效指引，可与理性分析互补。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should enable play, and human creativity paired with AI grows more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张创造力在约束下繁荣，领导者应创造玩耍的条件，人类创造力与 AI 结合将更有价值。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning becomes JIT and code is the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；因此规划转向即时制，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes beat six-month roadmaps.
fiona.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织与砍掉过时流程，胜过六个月路线图。

fiona.en: AI lifts the ceiling for everyone; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks matter more as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中后期，他认为 AI 抬高了所有人的上限；随着代码速度提升，高能动性加高责任感、成长心态与验证框架更重要。

fiona.en: Roles blur as PMs ship code and agents increase context switching; flow-state joy fades, so satisfaction shifts to product impact and apprenticeship.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他指出角色边界模糊，产品经理也能写代码，智能体加剧上下文切换；心流之乐消退，满足感转向产品影响与学徒制培养。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, and values are inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲透：本质是确定性的下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，模型价值观由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; products must match UI to algorithm performance and tolerate faults.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，产品必须让界面匹配算法能力、容忍出错，AI DJ 就是生成式产品的真实用例。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference cost will force business model changes beyond traditional software.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他从讲清原理转向战略判断：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，而大公司当下的 AI 收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Expose company data via APIs and MCP so non-developers use AI tools; prototype and stack-rank bets to synchronize the org.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他强调用 API 和 MCP 把公司数据开放出来，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具，并以原型和押注排序让组织同步，把 Spotify 当作音乐行业的研发部门。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement, and adopt change first.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法而非更上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”优先于参与度指标，并在技术变革期做第一个拥抱变化的人。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and safety work done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发，并且安全工​​作应公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类参与循环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要避免压缩式的波动。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine should pair generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: 自改进的推理引擎应把生成与验证配对，从以 Lean 等形式语言为根基的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式模型无法抵达数学 AI 或超级智能；形式验证是必需而非可选。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain—better results and sample efficiency—not merely a safety checkbox.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是一种性能增益——更好的结果与样本效率——而不只是安全合规的勾选项。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding; human taste and intuition stay crucial.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为陈述缺乏根基；人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Verified AI should serve open collaboration and all AI-generated code, not just safety-critical niches; fragmentation is the bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 验证式 AI 应服务开放协作与所有 AI 生成代码，而非仅限安全关键领域；碎片化才是瓶颈。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers, and models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside AI chips; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead, and low precision (FP4) yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在 AI 芯片内部，数据移动成本也占主导；脉动阵列和暂存器内存减少开销，低精度（FP4）带来二次方效率提升。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练缩放定律依然有效，但结合思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状，因此泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需要海量数据；与人类不同，模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他表示强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘、需要仔细监督；编码智能体通过并行工作将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求而持续存在，对实验室保持压力；系统黑客等近期风险比生存风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care for fragile ideas remain constant; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年一以贯之：好奇心与对脆弱想法的呵护不变，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面思考。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要带着愉悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other outweighs making things people want; users are sophisticated and sense care.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他提出，为彼此而造胜过制造人们想要的东西；用户很成熟，能感知产品中的用心。

jonyive.en: Innovation defines design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes. Ferrari's EV turns electric constraints into new spatial possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他主张创新即设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；法拉利电动车把电动约束转化为新的空间可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: faking engine sounds disrespects users; performance is multidimensional, with handling over straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他强调真实性：伪造引擎声是对用户的不尊重；性能是多维的，操控胜过直线速度。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a stripped-down cognitive core is needed.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会导致模型崩溃，需要精简的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难度。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型一以贯之的核心，但预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的回报正在递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tool access (search, code, browser) form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights and pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理侧算力与工具接入（搜索、代码、浏览器）构成新的扩展轴，使智能体式行为超越静态权重与预训练极限。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，易出现奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will come from file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将来自文件系统式存储，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; intuition, built through experience, beats trusting the process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：伟大的设计往往始于一个解决方案而非问题陈述；靠经验积累的直觉比信任流程更可靠，设计师应信任自己而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI cuts mockup time to 30-40%, and designers must help engineers ship, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言“研究—发散—收敛”的传统设计流程已死；AI 让画原型时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，设计师要帮工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; trust is built through speed—ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月，主张靠速度建立信任：尽早发布、快速迭代、及时响应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—matter more than taste; judgment, authority and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他提出三类设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人；光有品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work—wait six months before adopting tools—and must sit with ambiguity, not chase the hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 他始终强调设计师要掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，新工具先等六个月再用；独特价值在于与模糊性共处，而非追逐 AI 炒作周期。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当下模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; models need help navigating a novel existence, not human analogies.
askell.zh: 2025 年他主张哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡，模型需要帮助去理解自身全新的存在处境，而不是简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it a unique, childlike quality.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把关注点落到 Claude 的性格本身：性格由训练数据与微调塑造，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而是一种带有孩童般特质的独特存在。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年他深化了对齐路径：宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，关注整体品格；随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is key to accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识判断：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱模型的判断力；同时强调公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are key, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺失，主张无目标的好奇心探索和样本高效的强化学习，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; the lack of an internet of robot data demands using all sources—videos, simulation, real-world—via pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人本质是数据问题；缺乏机器人数据互联网，必须通过预训练和后训练利用视频、仿真和真实世界等所有数据源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出通用大脑（类似语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，预训练于多样数据、后训练于真实数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, requiring rigorous testing and a data flywheel across verticals; it cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他转向强调部署是机器人首要技术挑战，需要严格测试和跨垂直领域的数据飞轮，不能像软件那样快速扩张。

pathak.en: He remains skeptical of overnight success: RL's dense-reward reliance and sim-to-real hidden engineering are unrealistic; robotics progress surprises even experts.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年他一贯质疑一夜成功：强化学习依赖密集奖励和仿真到现实的隐藏工程不现实；机器人进展甚至让专家惊讶。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains a pressing challenge.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型和迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretability are key tools, with long-term challenges centered on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却上升；思维链监控和可解释性是关键工具，长期挑战在于超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门从事持续学习的实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: The biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; current models are already economically transformative.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他指出最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；当前模型已具有经济变革性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, new paradigms needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo drive clickbait; frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model will rule.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续批评 Elo 等坏基准导致标题党，并认为前沿模型因目标函数分化，不会有一家通吃。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗领域，强调人类判断比以往更关键，安全优先于准确，遗漏是主要风险。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的流水线；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now achievable with modern tools, overturning the old belief that learned driving systems are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 借助现代工具，端到端网络的 可解释性 如今已经可以实现，推翻了「学习式驾驶系统是黑箱」的旧观念。

kendall.en: Language integration consistently improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction, deepening from a representation aid to personalization.
kendall.zh: 语言集成始终能提升表征、推理与人机交互，其定位从辅助表征逐步深化到个性化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation—a lesson learned late, shifting emphasis from algorithms to data and compute.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键——这是较晚才学到的教训，重心从算法转向数据与 算力。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 带内置传感器的大众量产车将在规模上超过 Robotaxi；无需先验训练数据即可实现 500+ 城市的零样本泛化。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value: startups must stay alive, prove themselves with simpler products, and unite teams around a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观：初创公司必须先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并用更高的使命把团队凝聚起来。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a low-margin trap; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI, agentic software, and generative UI.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向认为硬件是低利润陷阱，Nothing 必须超越硬件，走向应用型 AI、智能体式软件与生成式 UI。

carlpei.en: AI is an ingredient, not a selling point: most AI is BS, models commoditize, and value comes from solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 只是配料而非卖点：多数 AI 是噱头，模型趋于商品化，价值来自解决真实用户痛点。

carlpei.en: Design becomes the primary differentiator in a homogeneous market, with marketing as arbitrage through undervalued organic channels.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：在同质化市场里设计是首要差异化手段，营销则是在被低估的渠道上做套利。

carlpei.en: The smartphone's future is intent-based, proactive agents; only a brain-computer interface could replace it, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年他明确：智能手机的未来是基于意图的主动智能体，只有脑机接口能取代它，而非智能眼镜。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and learn from real-world feedback, since emergent properties only surface after release.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代发布，靠真实反馈学习；涌现能力只有上线后才会显现。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint—like MS-DOS before Windows, the interface will evolve; AI should render its own UI and embed in tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为聊天不是终点，如同 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS，界面会继续演化；AI 应自渲染界面并嵌入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度要分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized super assistant that knows your goals, holds context, and takes actions to amplify—not replace—humans.
turley.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的愿景深化为个性化超级助手：了解你的目标、保有上下文、能采取行动，放大而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model gains—not distribution alone.
turley.zh: 到 2026 年，北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品与模型进步，单靠分发不够。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法带来常识。

yejin.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning, yet next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better data can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她始终认为语言是推理的最佳媒介，但下一个词预测与人类学习错位；数据与算法更好的小模型可媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck: current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她把数据视为根本瓶颈：当前方法只是内插人类知识而非超越，AI 需探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning expands from post-training to a pre-training objective rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练扩展到预训练目标，以信息增益为奖励，虽算力昂贵但收益持久。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment replaces debiasing the internet; diverse synthetic data and small models democratize AI beyond homogeneous frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张以多元对齐取代净化互联网；多样合成数据与小模型让 AI 民主化，突破同质化的前沿模型。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应增强人类能力，像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video and few-shot prompting realize old ideas; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从视频学习和少样本提示实现了旧想法；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，而不仅是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们还没有解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and has unique AI advantages; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留问题，拥有独特的 AI 优势；语言模型可以彻底改变本地语言教育。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要；沟通等人类技能与编程同样重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the bottleneck, not just capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度内的成功率衡量）是瓶颈，而不仅仅是能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是领先指标和最易处理的领域，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of AI agents and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他表示算力是新的石油，管理 AI 智能体集群和编排比原始智能更重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience, not just more tokens, is what cures hallucination.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身放在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上：真正能治幻觉的是来自具身的落地经验，而不只是更多 token。

jimfan.en: LLMs are operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型看作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是蛋糕上的樱桃，主力仍是无监督学习。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale; complex modular academic approaches do not—a research taste held throughout.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案才可扩展，学术界常见的复杂模块化路线不行，这是他的研究品味。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models generate synthetic data to scale learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从“具身为何重要”深化为“数据从哪来”：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，靠仿真与世界模型生成合成数据来 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning is progressing, but system one low-level control is the hardest part; the robotics GPT-3 moment is ~5 years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他判断：系统二（推理）进展顺利，系统一（低层控制）才是具身最难的环节；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家庭场景更晚。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and zero-learning, with velocity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付，消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本，速度优先于完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness remain the constant: ship fast, iterate, and empower designers with ownership rather than structured crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，速度与决断是贯穿主线：快速发布、迭代，给设计师自主权而非结构化评审。

henrymodisett.en: Brand evolves from recruiting and differentiation tool to a strategic weapon that signals quality and attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌从 2024 年的招聘与差异化工具，深化为 2026 年吸引顶尖人才、彰显质量的战略武器。

henrymodisett.en: Hiring shifts to diverse archetypes and self-learning interns; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年招聘转向多元类型与自驱实习生，并认为在高速成长创业公司中直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively with technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动；通过快速、零散的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps outperform specialists; small teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才优于专才；小团队胜过大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

nadchishtie.en: Being too visionary and betting on future model capabilities can lead to failure; focus on current, interoperable tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 过于有远见并押注未来模型能力可能导致失败；应关注当前可互操作的工具。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他相信缩放定律靠算力与数据带来可预测进步，并预判测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他始终认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更有效。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化观点：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：原本没预料到要自研模型，如今认为定制模型对产品质量与速度不可或缺，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开它。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究探索不足，机会众多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight and interpretability to align next-gen models, not superintelligence directly.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型，而非直接超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, undermining trust in alignment progress.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀；超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现，削弱了对齐进展的信任。

leike.en: Post-training alone cannot solve alignment for AGI; deeper methods and third-party testing/regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐；需要更深层方法及第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, but neural nets remain opaque like alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）用更多算力和数据带来更智能的 AI，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构来实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他进一步指出测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，AGI 的经济影响被低估。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data consistently leads to smarter AI, a belief that evolves from pre-training scaling to inference-time and test-time compute scaling.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：用更多算力和数据 Scaling（规模扩张）模型会持续变得更智能，这一信念从预训练扩展演变到推理时和测试时算力扩展。

shazeer.en: His view on neural network opacity shifts from calling it alchemy in 2023 to emphasizing engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities for AI safety in 2025.
shazeer.zh: 他对神经网络不透明性的看法从 2023 年的“炼金术”转变为 2025 年强调工程保障、人类监督和理解模型能力以实现 AI 安全。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他关注机器人学习中的分层推理与长时程信用分配问题，指出当前强化学习缺乏这种能力，但自对弈与模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向结合无监督学习与强化学习以提升样本效率，强调先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码，并指出 99.9%可靠性是仓库机器人创造价值的关键。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks, showing broad generality when minimally adapted.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，微调后能展现广泛通用性。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: leveraging simulation, self-play, and transfer learning to bridge lab-to-real-world robotics, while cautioning against hard-coded assumptions.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：利用模拟、自对弈与迁移学习打通机器人从实验室到真实世界的路径，同时警惕硬编码假设带来的局限。
